description: This file defines an interface for a grain with recursive type handling and a related serializable class structure, including a recursive type and a self-typed base class, used for testing or reproducing a specific bug in Orleans project.

classes.name: RecursiveType
classes.description: A serializable class that inherits from SelfTyped<RecursiveType>, used for recursive data structures.

classes.name: SelfTyped<T>
classes.description: A generic abstract class serving as a self-referential base class, used to create recursive type hierarchies.

methods.name: Echo
methods.description: Asynchronous method in the grain interface that takes a RecursiveType argument and returns a RecursiveType, used for testing recursive serialization.
